source_read: Full word/document.xml text, including all story criteria, sprint task tables and responsibility sections

user_overrides.scope: Visual and interactive academic web prototype; no deployed production backend or physical IoT sensors

evidence_limits: Creating planning artifacts does not complete the underlying user stories.
Original server, release, field trial and microphone privacy acceptance criteria cannot be demonstrated by interface mockups alone.
No historical meetings, interviews, tests, approvals, commits or team participation are inferred from the plan.
Social GPA rewards and campus analytics are user-requested prototype additions, not replacements for original story IDs.
